description: Cold-execution investigation on September 12, 2026. Experimental guests were not published.

method.snapshot_note: Experimental snapshots were made on nyx. Guest clock calibration differs; compare host wall and browser CPU time, not guest time.
method.cache_note: cat of the binary or all closure files completes before the execution timer starts. Prefetch cost is excluded. Each sample starts a fresh browser and guest.

control.change: Unmodified 7.2.5 kernel and initramfs, with a fresh snapshot.

nonpreempt.change: Remove PREEMPT_NONE dependency on ARCH_NO_PREEMPT in kernel/Kconfig.preempt, retaining CONFIG_PREEMPT_NONE=y from the existing fragment. Diagnostic source patch only.

nostrings.change: Unmodified 7.2.5 kernel; append clearcpuid=erms,rep_good to the guest command line before snapshotting.

tiny.change: Add CONFIG_SLUB_TINY=y before olddefconfig; retain stock 7.2.5 preemption.

lts.change: Build Linux 6.18.49 from the pinned nixpkgs source using the existing guest config and compiler. Remove the unsupported negtimeout=0 mount option from the initramfs and take a fresh snapshot.

validation.worker_profile: No usable worker profile collected; profiled timing runs excluded.

negative_cache_variant: Remove ,negtimeout=0 from the 7.2.5 initramfs mount command and retake the snapshot; retain the default 24-hour negative cache.
